tools.description: Parse Python files under /testbed with the AST to report definitions and call sites that match a callable name, including decorated wrappers, argument lists, and surrounding source. Helps trace callable signatures and argument-binding layers before editing.
tools.label: Callable Signature Survey
tools.name: callable_signatures

file_pattern.description: Python regular expression matched against file basenames; defaults to .*[.]py$.

include_calls.description: Whether to include call sites in addition to definitions; defaults to true.

max_results.description: Maximum number of definitions and maximum number of call sites to include; defaults to 40.

name.description: Exact Python function or method name to survey; matching definitions and call sites are reported.

search_path.description: Directory under /testbed to survey recursively; relative values resolve under /testbed; defaults to /testbed.

tools.description: Search text files under /testbed for a Python regular expression and return line-numbered context snippets. Useful for locating event names, reader/transform functions, and all call sites before changing code. Pure static search: does not modify files, run commands, or inspect history.
tools.label: Static Code Search
tools.name: code_search

context_lines.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match; defaults to 3.

file_pattern.description: Python regular expression matched against each file basename; defaults to .*[.]py$.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to include in the output; defaults to 50.

pattern.description: Python regular expression to search for in file contents.

search_path.description: Directory under /testbed to search recursively; relative values resolve under /testbed; defaults to /testbed.
